purpose: Record the hand fit of the production V-B return tube clip on the Mark 1 coupon.
tried: black quarter-inch LLDPE tubing seated through the split quarter-turn clip on a printed crop of the cold-core lid
visible_result: The tube follows the full bend between both pairs of wings and extends past both ends of the printed seat.
scope: Hand fit of the tube in the printed clip.

production_comparison.result: Cropping the current production lid with the coupon tool reproduces the printed STL byte for byte and the same infill regions inside the crop. The full-lid native slice includes the V-B clip and root.
